meta.content: A curious little monkey visits the zoo and meets five animals.

level2.p: Max was a little monkey who was curious about everything.
One sunny morning, his keeper Oliver said, "Max, would you like to go to the zoo today?"
Max jumped up and down with excitement. He loved the zoo!
They walked through the big gate and into the zoo. The first animal they saw was very tall indeed.

img.alt: A giraffe stretching its long neck up to eat leaves from the treetops

imggroup.caption: The giraffe stretched its long neck up high to eat leaves from the tallest trees.

level2.p: Max had never seen anything so tall. He looked up and up and up. Then he tried to stretch his own neck tall, too. Oliver laughed.

level3.p: A giraffe's neck can be nearly two metres long. That is taller than most grown-up people!

level2.p: Next, they came to a sandy yard where a big brown animal with two humps was eating hay.

img.alt: A camel with two humps looking at the viewer with large sleepy eyes

imggroup.caption: The camel looked at Max with large, sleepy eyes.

level2.p: Max was curious. What was under those humps? Were they hollow? Could he sit on top?
Before Oliver could say anything, Max climbed over the fence. But the zookeeper was fast! She carried Max safely back out, shaking her head.

level3.p: A camel's humps are not full of water. They are full of fat, which gives the camel energy on long desert journeys.

level2.p: Then Max heard a loud splash. He ran ahead to a big blue pool.

img.alt: A dolphin leaping out of the water

imggroup.caption: A gray dolphin leaped out of the water and flew through the air.

level2.p: The dolphin dove back in and splashed everyone at the edge. Max was soaked! He shook the water from his fur and laughed. The dolphin seemed to laugh too.

level3.p: Dolphins are very clever animals. They talk to each other using clicks and whistles.

level2.p: In the petting zoo, a keeper was feeding small animals. Max kneeled down and saw a round, prickly creature in the straw.

img.alt: A small hedgehog curled up into a tight ball

imggroup.caption: The little hedgehog curled up into a tight ball.

level2.p: Max reached out a finger very carefully. The hedgehog uncurled just enough to sniff. Its tiny nose tickled Max's finger. Max giggled. The keeper smiled.

level3.p: A hedgehog has about five thousand spines on its back. When it is scared, it rolls into a ball so the spines point outward.

level2.p: As the day grew late, Oliver said, "One more stop, Max."
They walked into a dark building called the Night House. Max held Oliver's hand tight. Then, high above, something swooped through the air!

img.alt: A bat gliding on wide wings in the dark

imggroup.caption: A bat glided on its wide wings through the darkness.

level2.p: More bats flew past, silent as shadows. Max watched them go round and round in the cool dark air. He was not afraid. He was curious.

level3.p: Bats find their way in the dark by making high sounds and listening to the echoes. This is called echolocation.

level2.p: Max waved goodbye to the bats, the hedgehog, the dolphin, the camel, and the giraffe. It had been a wonderful day at the zoo.
